exposure: vaginal misoprostol and intracervical foley catheter
cohort: Pregnant women in their third trimester at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Darbhanga Medical College and Hospital, Laheriasarai, Bihar.
finding: Compared to misoprostol alone, the combination of foley catheter and vaginal misoprostol resulted in a shorter time between induction and delivery.
mod_finding: The majority of women in both groups delivered vaginally.
